summary: ÅLESUND SPELEMANNSLAG (org. no. 979 287 372) is an association (FLI), in the Brønnøysund registers since 1997-10-02. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 90.201 (Utøvende kunstnerisk virksomhet og underholdningsvirksomhet innenfor musikk); it has 0 registered employees. Board chair: Helene Ingvill Slettebakk Gjerde.
